description: Create your own non-expiring API token after interactive login and save it to the selected private env file. Returns metadata and file path only. Existing tokens are never overwritten. Configure the MCP process to load this file; never copy the token into a prompt. Reuse the original Idempotency-Key after uncertain creation.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: token_create
